name: Nelumbo
source:
The protagonist, Florentina, comes from a magical, prestigious Nelumbo family who are known to maintain the transitions of seasons as Guardian of the Seasons. Florentina's grandmother, who is the current holder to the title, believes it is time to pass the tradition to her only grandchild. Although given such an opportunity to receive such a prestigious title, she cannot help but dread being forced into such a serious task and regularly skipped on her lessons from her grandmother. Through the help of grandmother's storytelling, Florentina learns about the history of Nelumbo, the goddess of seasons.

[From [url=https://sprinkle-theory.itch.io/nelumbo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角弗洛伦蒂娜来自一个神奇而享有盛誉的荷花家族，他们以季节守护者的身份维持着季节的更替而闻名。弗洛伦蒂娜的祖母是目前这一头衔的持有者，她认为是时候将这一传统传给她唯一的孙子了。尽管有这样的机会获得如此有声望的头衔，她还是忍不住害怕被迫承担如此严肃的任务，并经常跳过祖母的课程。在祖母的讲故事的帮助下，弗洛伦蒂娜了解了季节女神荷花的历史。

[来自[url=https://sprinkle-theory.itch.io/nelumbo]Itch.io[/url]]
